Name: Nyx's Wizard Furniture Catalogue Ultimate Recolor
Author: NyxInReverie
Description:
[size=4]This started as a simple recolor but quickly ballooned into a giant project. There are 10 colors to choose from (5 light & 5 dark) and 2 accent colors for a total of 20 variations! This mod is currently only available for Content Patcher but I am working on an Alternative Textures version![/size]

[size=4][b]10 Main Colors:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Dark Blue (default)[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Dark Green[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Dark Orange[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Dark Purple[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Dark Red[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Light Blue[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Light Green[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Light Orange[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Pink[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Yellow[/size][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]2 Accent Colors[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Gold (default)[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Silver[/size][/*]
[/list]
[size=4]This mod includes an i18n file for the config. Feel free to create and upload translation files![/size]

[size=4][b]Future Plans[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]AT version[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]3 more wood variants[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]More color variants[/size][/*]
[*]A "Wizard Furniture Extended Catalogue" mod that includes new furniture in my Wizard Catalogue style (child bed, couch, window, etc)[/*]
[/list]
